_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Clara is auditing your bank statement…

description: Parses and audits bank CSV statements (Revolut, AIB, Bank of Ireland, PTSB, N26, Bunq, Monzo, Nationwide, generic CSVs). ULTRA-FAST MODE FOR >120 ROWS: Group by (Month YYYY-MM-15, Description WITH original "To "/"Transfer to "/"Payment from " prefix intact, +/-, Type) into a ~40-90 line 5-column `Date,Description,Amount,Count,Type` CSV (keeping single items >=1000 as Count=1 — NEVER collapse multiple months into 1 undated row per merchant!) AND pass `statementStartDate` (exact earliest YYYY-MM-DD in raw CSV), `statementEndDate` (exact latest YYYY-MM-DD in raw CSV), `closingBalanceEur`, and `accountHolderName` (if known). Include ALL external salary/SEPA credits (+Amount, including Revolut Type="TOPUP" employer payroll like Optum); exclude only REVERTED/FAILED/DECLINED/PENDING, EXCHANGE, crypto/Revolut Digital Assets, Pocket/Vault moves, and card/own-bank self top-ups.

accountHolderName.description: Optional account holder first or full name (if known from user context or statement header) so transfers to the user’s own external accounts (e.g. "To <OwnName>") are automatically excluded from expenses.

appendToExistingSession.description: Set true to combine this CSV (or CSV chunk) with statements already loaded in your current session.

closingBalanceEur.description: Optional latest closing account balance in EUR (use when emitting compact/grouped CSV rows without a Balance column).

csvBase64.description: Optional base64-encoded CSV file bytes (handles UTF-8, UTF-16, and Windows-1252 bank exports).

csvFiles.description: Optional array of multiple CSV statements (e.g. Current Account + Credit Card) to merge and analyze together.

csvText.description: CSV statement text. For >120 rows, pass a monthly-grouped 5-column "Date,Description,Amount,Count,Type" (or 4-column "Date,Description,Amount,Count") CSV keeping "To "/"Transfer to "/"Payment from " prefixes intact.

csvUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a CSV attachment or signed download link.

sessionId.description: Optional label within your isolated connection session (defaults to "default") for follow-up ledger queries or Sankey diagrams.

statementEndDate.description: Exact latest transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the raw CSV statement. REQUIRED whenever passing grouped CSV rows so Clara normalizes monthly spend over the exact statement window.

statementStartDate.description: Exact earliest transaction date (YYYY-MM-DD) in the raw CSV statement. REQUIRED whenever passing grouped CSV rows so Clara normalizes monthly spend over the exact statement window (e.g. 3.75 months).

name: analyze_bank_csv
